result.eventDescription: One delivered screenshot: $25 per 1,000 rows. Row keys source_url, title, viewport_width, viewport_height, full_page, height_capped, blocked_requests. No start fee; compute and network included. Nested data and any documented file included. Empty extractions, duplicates, exclusions and failures without delivered rows are free. Invalid-syntax email, DNS NXDOMAIN and RDAP not-found diagnostic rows are billed where applicable. Stops at maxTotalChargeUsd (run option, not input); partial failures retain delivered row charges.
